name: NeonGlass
author: Muichiro Dev
description:
NeonGlass is a modern liquid-glass theme for Pelican Panel: frosted, refractive glass surfaces with specular highlights, neon accent glows and floating colour orbs across the admin, app and server panels.

The server list becomes a custom dashboard: glass hero banner with live status chips, grid / list / compact layouts, glass server cards with CPU / RAM meters, status glow, pins and a "/" search shortcut, plus a floating glass tab bar on phones. Also: dark and light modes, 11 neon accent hues, corner radius and glass intensity settings, curated console palettes and a full settings page. Settings are stored in .env. Self-contained assets, EN / ES / FR / PT-BR / DE, respects prefers-reduced-motion and reduced-transparency. MIT licensed.
